hero.title: Visualize complex logic with drag-and-drop simplicity
hero.description: A powerful canvas for building interactive nodes and connections. Design complex workflows, manage application data, and automate processes on the fly.

heading.title: Powering Your Workflows
heading.description: Six precision-engineered mechanisms, machined for the modern automation workshop.

visual-editor.title: Visual Node Editor
visual-editor.description: Design complex data flows effortlessly using drag-and-drop node mechanics with native connection validation and instant reactivity.

event-triggers.title: Event-Driven Triggers
event-triggers.description: Execute actions conditionally. Connect custom trigger nodes like on_click or webhooks to downstream payloads instantly.

zero-lag.title: Zero-Lag Canvas
zero-lag.description: Experience ultra-smooth navigation. Fully optimized zoom-locked interactions, hardware-accelerated panning, and layout protection.

schema-control.title: Strict Schema Control
schema-control.description: Ensure data integrity between source and target connections. Mismatched node ports block incompatible payloads automatically.

collaborative-rooms.title: Collaborative Rooms
collaborative-rooms.description: Build and debug pipelines together in real-time. Share workspaces with your team instantly with live presence and cursor tracking.

one-click-deploy.title: One-Click Deploy
one-click-deploy.description: Push your validated nodes to production with a single click. Scale automatically on serverless edge runtimes without cold starts.

cta.subtitle: Assembly Instructions
cta.title: Ready to fire up your first pipeline?
cta.description: Combine inputs, actions, and custom webhooks inside a secure browser-based engine room.

heading.title: How It Works
heading.description: Go from a blank canvas to a production-ready, event-driven API in five mechanical steps. No complex infra hosting required.

design.title: Drag and Connect Nodes
design.subtitle: Design Phase
design.description: Select from over 100+ pre-built triggers, actions, and logical operators. Drag them onto the zero-lag canvas and route your data by connecting matching output-to-input ports.

validate.title: Configure Payloads
validate.subtitle: Validation Phase
validate.description: Click on any node to open its properties. Map incoming JSON fields, write custom mapping expressions with autocomplete support, and let our strict schema engine validate your connections.

deploy.title: Deploy and Run
deploy.subtitle: Production Phase
deploy.description: Hit Deploy to publish your workspace. Your workflow immediately compiles into a highly optimized, stateful execution pipeline running on global edge nodes.

monitor.title: Monitor Pipeline Health
monitor.subtitle: Telemetry Phase
monitor.description: Watch real-time pressure gauges and throughput metrics. Our built-in observability suite catches bottlenecks before they cause a system failure.

scale.title: Scale Infrastructure
scale.subtitle: Expansion Phase
scale.description: Allocate more compute to your boilers. The system automatically provisions additional edge workers to handle traffic spikes without breaking a sweat.

heading.title: Trusted by modern engineering teams
heading.description: Powering the world's most demanding automation pipelines.

heading.title: Designed for Modern Workloads
heading.description: Explore how engineering teams leverage our visual editor to orchestrate critical business events and automate infrastructure.

01.title: LLM & Agentic Orchestration
01.description: Chain multi-step prompts, validate schema boundaries between models, and integrate custom vector database tools via standard API nodes.

02.title: Notification Dispatcher
02.description: Route real-time alerts dynamically across Slack, email, and Webhooks based on user action payloads and custom conditional rules.

03.title: Lightweight ETL Pipelines
03.description: Extract payloads from incoming webhooks, transform fields in real-time, and securely batch load clean datasets straight to Postgres.

04.title: Auto-Mitigation Workflows
04.description: Trigger security logic when an anomaly is detected. Block IP addresses on Cloudflare and rotate API tokens instantly without human delay.
